wd-106.t: If you get this text, don't tap it: fake delivery text red flags
wd-106.cap:
If you get this text, don't tap it: fake delivery text red flags
A fake "your package couldn't be delivered" text with a tiny fee is one of the most common scam texts. Learn 4 red flags once, and you can check any text in seconds.

1. It rushes or threatens you ("pay today or it goes back")
2. A link you didn't ask for
3. An odd number or sender
4. It wants a code or card number

Spot one? Don't tap. Check your order in the store's or carrier's own app (typed yourself). Forward the text to 7726 (free on most US carriers), then delete it. Already tapped and paid? Call the number on the back of your card.
